first_missing_criterion: A usable official no-login data endpoint for Exeter City Council's listed-building-outline dataset is missing: the official Planning Data authority overview currently reports "Endpoint URL not submitted" for Listed building outline. Therefore no record-level building Polygon/MultiPolygon payload can be queried from Exeter's authoritative endpoint in this window, and no building type/use record can be accepted.
